description: Permanently delete Besidka chats with their messages, the memory learned only from them and the files only they produced. This cannot be undone. A chat that is generating a reply is skipped (a best-effort check). Reports the deleted slugs and the skipped ones with the reason: not_found, generating or error (try again). Requires signing in (data:delete).
name: delete_chats
title: Delete chats
